title: PyTorch torch.optim.AdamW documentation (2.15)
summary: Fetched: defaults lr=1e-3, weight_decay=1e-2; decay applied directly to parameters (theta <- theta - lr*wd*theta) before the Adam step, outside the moment estimates. Cites arXiv:1711.05101.

title: Loshchilov & Hutter, Decoupled Weight Decay Regularization (ICLR 2019)
summary: Fetched abstract: L2 regularization and weight decay differ for adaptive optimizers; decoupling makes the optimal decay less dependent on learning rate and improves Adam generalization on image classification.

title: scikit-learn load_digits documentation
summary: Fetched: 1797 samples, 8x8 images, 64 integer features 0-16, 10 classes, ~180 per class; a copy of the UCI test set. Page states no data license.
license: BSD-3-Clause (scikit-learn docs/code); data terms via UCI

title: UCI Optical Recognition of Handwritten Digits (Alpaydin & Kaynak)
summary: Fetched: CC BY 4.0; 5620 instances; 43 writers (30 in the train set, 13 in the test set). load_digits is only the 1797-instance test portion; writer IDs are not provided, so a random split can mix writers across splits.

title: Hugging Face safetensors torch API
summary: Fetched: save_file(tensors, filename, metadata) requires contiguous dense tensors; load_file(filename, device) returns a dict of tensors. Matches study.py usage.

title: Neel Nanda, research process sequence (Alignment Forum)
summary: Fetched index only (titles): Explore/Understand/Distill; key mindsets; research taste; writing ML papers. Post bodies were not read this phase.

title: Lones, How to avoid machine learning pitfalls: a guide for academic researchers
summary: Fetched abstract: five stages - prepare, build reliably, evaluate robustly, compare fairly, report. Used as a checklist for leakage, fair comparison and uncertainty.
